subject: Request: DPIA & SCCs evidence for Metro Transit procurement
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@metro-transit.gov>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@metro-transit.gov>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0500
Subject: DPIA & SCCs evidence request for RFP #MT-2026-11

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Metro Transit is moving quickly on the cloud-hosted inference portion of the RFP. Procurement asked me to collect some evidence packs for the vendor file. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide: 

- Current SCCs (executed or template) for EU transfers
- A short DPIA summary showing our processing model + risk mitigations for location data and rider PII
- SOC 2 Type II report or at minimum a SOC summary and scope
- Any FedRAMP-adjacent controls mapping you maintain (we'll accept a CAIQ mapping)

We need these uploaded to the shared Drive by EOD Tue 30 Nov to pass the materials to counsel. If you prefer, we can accept a single zip via DocuSign link for signature later.

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Liu
Senior Procurement Analyst
Metro Transit Authority
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@metro-transit.gov>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: DPIA & SCCs evidence request for RFP #MT-2026-11

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble the materials and hit the 30 Nov deadline.

Quick notes:
- I'll upload a redacted SOC2 Type II summary and the SOC scope. Full SOC2 reports require an NDA/controlled exchange; if counsel needs full report we can arrange that.
- Grace will compile a concise DPIA summary focused on the rider PII and geolocation processing model.
- We have an executed SCCs template and a signed SCC for one EU customer — will include the template and guidance on the transfer impact assessment.
- We'll include a CAIQ mapping that highlights controls relevant to FedRAMP-adjacent requirements.

Grace and Marissa — can you coordinate and confirm which files we will drop to the Drive? I'll keep Sarah and Ben updated on timelines.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of G&A Sales Ops (covering public sector)
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: DPIA & SCCs evidence request for RFP #MT-2026-11

Tessa / Marissa — I'll take point on the DPIA summary and SCCs guidance. Plan:

1) DPIA summary (1–2 pages) — processing description, lawful basis, categories of data, retention, technical mitigations (encryption at rest/in motion, token-level access controls, KV cache handling), and residual risk + mitigation plan.
2) SCCs pack — include the executed template, a redaction guidance note, and transfer impact assessment bullet points (data flows to US-hosted inference, subprocessors list).
3) SOC2 materials — produce the summary + control mapping; flag that full report requires an executed CDA/NDA.
4) CAIQ mapping — highlight FedRAMP-adjacent controls we map to NIST SP 800-53 families.

Marissa — can you assemble the Drive folder and create the DocuSign envelope if procurement prefers signing? Also need to confirm whether MTA wants additional evidence for key management (KMS/HSM) and on-prem options; they asked questions in the RFP but didn't list in the email.

I'll draft the DPIA summary today and circulate a first pass by EOD Mon 29 Nov.

Grace O'Connor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
